description: This is a shell script library that defines functions to format test outputs into JUnit XML format for integration with CI pipelines like Azure Pipelines. It includes functions to start and finalize test suites and test cases, handle different test outcomes, and encode XML attributes.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes JUnit XML output for a test suite, creating directory and XML file, and starting the testsuite element.

methods.name: start_test_case_output
methods.description: Records the start time for a test case.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Finalizes the test case output with the test result, appending appropriate XML tags for success, failure, skipped, etc.

methods.name: finalize_test_output
methods.description: Completes the overall test suite XML by updating timing information and closing XML tags.

methods.name: write_junit_xml
methods.description: Writes provided XML content into the junit XML file, optionally truncating the file.

methods.name: xml_attr_encode
methods.description: Encodes strings for safe inclusion as XML attributes.
